Hello! Yes, you're welcome to ask questions here. What would you like to know?
thank you. I would like to know about a game called Pokémon Platinum. all of friends are talking about it all of sudden.

Pokémon Platinum is a role - playing game with adventure elements. It is a title in the Pokémon series of video games, and   it is an enhanced version of Pokémon Diamond and Pearl in the same vein as Pokémon Yellow , Crystal , and Emerald , which are remakes of Red and Blue , Gold and Silver , and Ruby and Sapphire , respectively. Its basic mechanics are the same as those found in Diamond and Pearl , featuring two - dimensional gameplay. Additionally, it was the fourth best - selling game worldwide in the third quarter of 2008.
enhanced version? that sounds cool. what are the new features?

Sure, here are some of the new features in Pokémon Platinum:
1. A new area called the "Wi-Fi Plaza" is added, which features several Pokémon-themed mini-games and allows up to 20 players to be present in it.
2. The Vs. Recorder is introduced, allowing players to record battles held in the Battle Frontier or on Wi-Fi.
3. The GTS system, which allows players to trade anonymously on the Wi-Fi connection, returns from the previous versions. A new feature of this system is that players can be notified via email when a trade has commenced, although this has been reduced to a message on the player's Wii outside Japan.
4. There are changes in the appearance and availability of Pokémon. For instance, Giratina, Shaymin, and Rotom all have new forms, and the trios of Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres, along with the trio of Regice, Regirock, and Registeel, have been added to the game.
5. The Battle Frontier, a feature first introduced in Pokémon Emerald, is added.
6. Pokémon Contests play similarly to Diamond and Pearl's, but there are some changes in the awarding of ribbons.
7. Baked goods called Poffins can be made from berries and fed to Pokémon to improve their traits.
8. Platinum offers compatibility with the Game Boy Advance Pokémon RPGs. Players can upload Pokémon from Platinum to the Wii games Pokémon Battle Revolution and My Pokémon Ranch.
9. A significant addition is the Distortion World, which features distorted physics versus those in the standard game.
what do you think of the game?

I think I can recommend this game to you since Pokémon Platinum has received generally positive reception. It holds an aggregate score of 84 / 100 and 83.14 % at Metacritic and GameRankings, respectively. It is the 56th highest rated Nintendo DS game and the 1,542 nd highest rated video game on Game Rankings.
thank you. when was this game announced?

Pokémon Platinum was first announced on May 15, 2008. It was eventually released on September 13 , 2008 , in Japan ; March 22 , 2009 , in North America ; May 14 , 2009 in Australia ; and May 22 , 2009 , in Europe
